## Common WHERE Filters

### Partition Filters
```sql
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### Date Range Filter
```sql
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE('${grass_date}'), 2) AND DATE('${grass_date}')
```

### Placement Filter (Cold Start / Ads MKT)
```sql
WHERE placement in (0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 802, 805, 1000, 1002, 1005, 1200, 1202, 1205, 20)
```

### Order Detection Filter
```sql
WHERE order_cnt > 0
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN with dim_advertiser (Shop/Advertiser Info)
```sql
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertiser__reg_s0_live b
    ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id
   AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
WHERE b.grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND b.grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
```

### JOIN with dim_advertise (Ad Dimension Data)
```sql
LEFT OUTER JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live ads
    ON event.ads_id = ads.ads_id
   AND event.grass_region = ads.grass_region
   AND event.placement = ads.placement
   AND event.pricing_type <=> ads.pricing_type
WHERE ads.grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND ads.grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
```

## Common Aggregations

### Keyword-Level Rollup (dws_advertise_keyword_performance_1d)
```sql
SELECT  shop_id
       ,username
       ,item_id
       ,ads_id
       ,keywords
       ,match_type
       ,placement
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN impression_cnt ELSE 0 END)      AS impression_cnt_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN click_cnt ELSE 0 END)           AS click_cnt_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN expenditure_amt_local ELSE 0.0 END) AS expenditure_amt_local_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN expenditure_amt_usd ELSE 0.0 END)   AS expenditure_amt_usd_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN order_cnt ELSE 0 END)           AS order_cnt_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN ads_gmv_amt_local ELSE 0.0 END) AS ads_gmv_amt_local_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN ads_gmv_amt_usd ELSE 0.0 END)   AS ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d
       ,AVG(avg_ads_ranks)                                              AS avg_ads_ranks_1d
GROUP BY shop_id, username, item_id, ads_id, keywords, match_type, placement, grass_region
```

### Item-Level Rollup (dws_advertise_item_performance_1d)
```sql
SELECT  shop_id, item_id, item_name, ads_id, placement, user_name
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN impression_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS impression_cnt_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN click_cnt ELSE 0 END)      AS click_cnt_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN expenditure_amt_local ELSE 0.0 END) AS expenditure_amt_local_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN expenditure_amt_usd ELSE 0.0 END)   AS expenditure_amt_usd_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN order_cnt ELSE 0 END)      AS order_cnt_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN ads_gmv_amt_local ELSE 0.0 END) AS ads_gmv_amt_local_1d
       ,SUM(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN ads_gmv_amt_usd ELSE 0.0 END)   AS ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d
       ,AVG(CASE WHEN is_today = 1 THEN avg_ads_ranks END)         AS avg_ads_ranks_1d
GROUP BY shop_id, item_id, item_name, ads_id, placement, user_name, tz_type, grass_region, grass_date
```

### Ad-Level MKT Rollup (ads_advertise_mkt_1d - all metrics)
```sql
SELECT   ads_id, placement, ads_type, item_id, shop_id, seller_id, pricing_type, region, tz_type
        ,SUM(impression_cnt)           AS impression_cnt
        ,SUM(click_cnt)               AS click_cnt
        ,SUM(order_cnt)               AS order_cnt
        ,SUM(ads_items_sold_cnt)      AS ads_items_sold_cnt
        ,SUM(ads_gmv_amt_local)       AS ads_gmv_amt_local
        ,SUM(ads_gmv_amt_usd)         AS ads_gmv_amt_usd
        ,SUM(expenditure_amt_local)   AS expenditure_amt_local
        ,SUM(expenditure_amt_usd)     AS expenditure_amt_usd
        ,SUM(avg_ads_ranks * impression_cnt) AS avg_ads_ranks  -- weighted sum for later division
        ,SUM(broad_shopitem_click_cnt)        AS broad_shopitem_click_cnt
        ,SUM(broad_shopitem_impression_cnt)   AS broad_shopitem_impression_cnt
        ,SUM(broad_order_item_cnt)            AS broad_order_item_cnt
        ,SUM(broad_order_gmv_amt_local)       AS broad_order_gmv_amt_local
        ,SUM(broad_order_gmv_amt_usd)         AS broad_order_gmv_amt_usd
        ,SUM(broad_order_cnt)                 AS broad_order_cnt
        ,SUM(shopitem_impression_cnt)         AS shopitem_impression_cnt
        ,SUM(shopitem_click_cnt)              AS shopitem_click_cnt
        ,SUM(paid_order_cnt)                  AS paid_order_cnt
        ,SUM(paid_order_cnt_ytd)              AS paid_order_cnt_ytd
        ,SUM(confirmed_order_cnt)             AS confirmed_order_cnt
        ,SUM(confirmed_order_cnt_ytd)         AS confirmed_order_cnt_ytd
        ,SUM(checkout_cnt)                    AS checkout_cnt
        ,SUM(add_to_cart_cnt)                 AS add_to_cart_cnt
        ,SUM(add_to_cart_without_clicks_cnt)  AS add_to_cart_without_clicks_cnt
        ,SUM(broad_add_to_cart_cnt)           AS broad_add_to_cart_cnt
GROUP BY ads_id, placement, ads_type, item_id, shop_id, seller_id, pricing_type, region, tz_type
```

### Cold Start Performance (7d window)
```sql
SELECT   ads_id, placement
        ,SUM(COALESCE(impression_cnt, 0))   AS impression_cnt_7d
        ,SUM(COALESCE(order_cnt, 0))        AS order_cnt_7d
        ,SUM(COALESCE(broad_order_cnt, 0))  AS broad_order_cnt_7d
FROM     dws_advertise_query_gmv_event_1d
WHERE    grass_date <= date_sub(current_date, 1)
  AND    grass_date >= date_sub(current_date, 7)
GROUP BY ads_id, placement
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: Keyword Performance with advertiser join
```sql
SELECT a.shop_id, b.user_name AS username, a.item_id, a.ads_id,
       a.keywords, a.match_type, a.placement,
       COALESCE(impression_cnt, 0)      AS impression_cnt,
       COALESCE(click_cnt, 0)           AS click_cnt,
       COALESCE(expenditure_amt_local, 0.0)  AS expenditure_amt_local,
       COALESCE(expenditure_amt_usd, 0.0)    AS expenditure_amt_usd,
       COALESCE(order_cnt, 0)           AS order_cnt,
       COALESCE(ads_gmv_amt_local, 0.0) AS ads_gmv_amt_local,
       COALESCE(ads_gmv_amt_usd, 0.0)   AS ads_gmv_amt_usd,
       COALESCE(avg_ads_ranks, 0.0)     AS avg_ads_ranks,
       CASE WHEN a.grass_date = date('${grass_date}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_today
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_query_gmv_event_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
      AND tz_type = 'local'
) a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertiser__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
) b
ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
```

### Snippet 2: Item Performance with derived rates
```sql
SELECT  shop_id, user_name, item_id, ads_id, placement, item_name,
        impression_cnt_1d, click_cnt_1d,
        expenditure_amt_local_1d, expenditure_amt_usd_1d,
        COALESCE(expenditure_amt_local_1d / click_cnt_1d, 0.0)   AS cpc_local_1d,
        COALESCE(expenditure_amt_usd_1d / click_cnt_1d, 0.0)     AS cpc_usd_1d,
        order_cnt_1d, ads_gmv_amt_local_1d, ads_gmv_amt_usd_1d,
        COALESCE(click_cnt_1d / impression_cnt_1d, 0.0)           AS ctr_1d,
        COALESCE(order_cnt_1d / click_cnt_1d, 0.0)                AS cr_1d,
        COALESCE(expenditure_amt_local_1d / ads_gmv_amt_local_1d, 0.0) AS cir_1d,
        avg_ads_ranks_1d
FROM (
    SELECT  shop_id, item_id, item_name, ads_id, placement,
            seller_name AS user_name,
            COALESCE(impression_cnt, 0)       AS impression_cnt,
            COALESCE(click_cnt, 0)            AS click_cnt,
            COALESCE(expenditure_amt_local, 0.0)  AS expenditure_amt_local,
            COALESCE(expenditure_amt_usd, 0.0)    AS expenditure_amt_usd,
            COALESCE(order_cnt, 0)            AS order_cnt,
            COALESCE(ads_gmv_amt_local, 0.0)  AS ads_gmv_amt_local,
            COALESCE(ads_gmv_amt_usd, 0.0)    AS ads_gmv_amt_usd,
            COALESCE(avg_ads_ranks, 0.0)      AS avg_ads_ranks,
            CASE WHEN grass_date = date('${grass_date}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_today
    FROM    mp_paidads.dws_advertise_query_gmv_event_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE   grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND   grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
) t
GROUP BY shop_id, item_id, item_name, ads_id, placement, user_name
```

### Snippet 3: Cold Start Status Classification (7d window)
```sql
SELECT  ads_id, placement,
        CASE
            WHEN order_cnt_7d > 0 THEN 'Order success'
            WHEN order_cnt_7d = 0 AND broad_order_cnt_7d > 0 THEN 'Broad order success'
            WHEN order_cnt_7d = 0 AND broad_order_cnt_7d = 0 AND impression_cnt_7d <= 3000 THEN 'In progress'
            WHEN order_cnt_7d = 0 AND broad_order_cnt_7d = 0 AND impression_cnt_7d <= 9000 THEN 'Unsuccess'
            WHEN order_cnt_7d = 0 AND broad_order_cnt_7d = 0 AND impression_cnt_7d > 9000 THEN 'Low quality'
        END AS cold_start_status_7d
FROM (
    SELECT  ads_id, placement,
            SUM(COALESCE(impression_cnt, 0))  AS impression_cnt_7d,
            SUM(COALESCE(order_cnt, 0))       AS order_cnt_7d,
            SUM(COALESCE(broad_order_cnt, 0)) AS broad_order_cnt_7d
    FROM    ads_create_within_14d  -- CTE joining dim_advertise + this table
    WHERE   grass_date BETWEEN ADs_CREATE_DATE AND ADs_CREATE_DATE + 7
    GROUP BY ads_id, placement
)
```

### Snippet 4: First Order Detection
```sql
SELECT  ads_id, placement,
        DATE('${grass_date}') AS first_order_date
FROM    mp_paidads.dws_advertise_query_gmv_event_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE   grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND   grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND   tz_type = 'local'
  AND   placement IN (0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 802, 805, 1000, 1002, 1005, 1200, 1202, 1205, 20)
  AND   order_cnt > 0
GROUP BY ads_id, placement
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

### USD Conversion (from write INSERT)
- `ads_gmv_amt_usd = ads_order_gmv_local / dim.exchange_rate`
- `expenditure_amt_usd = expenditure_amt_local / dim.exchange_rate`
- `broad_order_gmv_amt_usd = broad_gmv_amt_local / dim.exchange_rate`

### Ad Rank (from write INSERT)
- `avg_ads_ranks = (SUM(location_in_ads) / SUM(impression_cnt) + 1)`

### CTR / CR / CIR (from downstream: keyword_performance, item_performance)
- `CPC = expenditure / click_cnt`
- `CTR = click_cnt / impression_cnt`
- `CR = order_cnt / click_cnt`
- `CIR = expenditure / ads_gmv`
- `Broad ROI = broad_order_gmv_amt_local / expenditure_amt_local`
